summary: Spawned in the Backrooms is a persistent survival RPG across Level 0, the Hub and authored Backrooms destinations. Character progression and gear live in player.state, while Solo/Multiplayer story state is switched separately; shared player behaviors, quests and local place sims connect the world. Radio Backrooms is Ralph's studio/guest room built by its sim, and Level 31 has a solo ephemeral maintenance underbelly beneath its rink.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze, routes and anomalies; Bonus Rooms door is north of the waking point in x0z0.
places/bonus + places/testlab (3D) - vaporwave mall, homes, atlas Teleport Station, interactive props and creator/body fixtures; glass-side Level 0 hall returns to the Lobby.
places/thehub (3D) - tunnel crossroads and Camp Amber; sim/helpers compose doors, destinations, crews and local interactions.
places/intake (3D), places/laundromat (solo ephemeral) and places/tutorial0 (solo ephemeral) - fresh-player creator/opening chain.

places/levelrun (solo ephemeral), places/level69 (solo ephemeral) and places/level22 (solo ephemeral) - Level ! hospital chase; highway car route and repeatable ramps; then Emstable decks, hazards, quest and return.
places/doors21 (3D) - Level 21 hotel square, four shifting numbered-door halls, dead-end bays, closets, nests and dark EXIT wing; Concierge/Wardens and a RADIO door.
places/level31 (3D) - The Roller Rink, with arcade/food court/rental/gift shop, service hatch behind the arcade back room, and return marker from its underbelly.
places/l31crawl (3D, solo ephemeral) - Level 31 dark maintenance underbelly; places/radio (3D) - Ralph's studio and guest room, generated and maintained by its sim.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer/player entry, camera and ordered player behavior/actions; scripts/ui.js and lib/screen.js compose the HUD and mutually exclusive panels.
templates/player.js inserts scripts/god-kit.js before scripts/player.js - builder god-mode toggle/refill precedes core player update and death handling.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/lib/run-opts.js - per-player arrival, fresh-character and mode/run routing; main-menu-ui.js renders title/pause and expedition settings.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, static placements and generation/tick behavior.
places/doors21/config.yaml + places/doors21/sim.js - Level 21 procedural square/halls/doors/dress, foe and NPC upkeep, reshaping and quest ticking.
places/level31/sim.js + scripts/lib/level31.js and level31-* helpers - Roller Rink shell/zones, dressing and local upkeep; hatch marker transitions to separately built crawl instance.

places/l31crawl/sim.js + scripts/lib/l31crawl.js - first-tick construction of the entire underbelly and recovery of players arriving before its floor is built; scripts/l31-bot.js manages bots, walkers and flickering lights.
places/radio/sim.js - versioned construction/maintenance of Ralph's studio, TV/ON AIR state and safety; scripts/radio-use.js handles usable studio/guest-room props.
shared: scripts/lib/level69-quest.js + scripts/lib/level22-quest.js - Wren dialogue/progression, beacon planting and Emstable exploration/record goals; consumed by talk, sims and level-specific props.
scripts/lib/doors21-quest.js - Concierge quest definitions/progression, NPC upkeep/dialogue and objective stepping; used by doors21 sim, npc-starters.js, talk.js and Hub Okafor dialogue.
scripts/lib/radio-quest.js + scripts/lib/data/dlg-radio.yml - Ralph's song requests, Milk for Ralph trade/secrets and guest spot; used by radio sim, npc-starters.js, talk.js and dialogue.js.
scripts/lib/radio.js + scripts/world-radio.js - shared station timeline/segment playback for HALOGEN and in-world receivers, including Radio Backrooms studio speakers.
scripts/lib/places.js - canonical place names/labels/HUD titles and atlas destinations; includes radio / Radio Backrooms and l31crawl / Level 31 · Underbelly.
scripts/lib/screen.js + scripts/lib/wrist-nav.js + scripts/lib/ui-theme.js - shared panel-state decisions, wrist tabs and journal-style styling; player behaviors and UI panels reuse them.
scripts/lib/survival.js + scripts/lib/afk.js - needs-aware stamina recovery/status and AFK tracking; player.js, craft.js and craft-ui.js consume them.
scripts/lib/grid-path.js - configurable 4-neighbor grid BFS/cache/cell selection shared by Level 0, 1, 2, 2.1, 3, Boiler and 6 adapters.
notableExports: scripts/lib/places.js - PLACES, PLACE_NAMES, PLACE_LABELS, LEVEL_TITLES; scripts/lib/l31crawl.js - M, AREAS, DOORS, LIGHTS, PROPS, BOTS, FOES, REWARD, buildCrawl.
places/l31crawl/sim.js - cadence, tick; scripts/l31c-door.js - ears.press, update; scripts/l31-bot.js - update; scripts/radio-use.js - ears.press.
places/radio/sim.js - cadence, tick; scripts/lib/radio-quest.js - RALPH, SONGS, QM, keepRadio, radioChoices, handleDialogueQuestRadio.
places/doors21/sim.js - cadence, tick; scripts/l21d-door.js - ears.press; scripts/l21d-foes.js - ears.noise, update; scripts/l21d-hole.js - onTriggerEnter.
scripts/lib/l21d-layout.js - place/dimensions/timing, hall/door/shift/warp/wing/arrival helpers incl. RADIO target; scripts/lib/l21d-body.js - CLIPS, foeBody.
scripts/lib/doors21-quest.js - CONCIERGE, OKAFOR, TRAY_DOOR, QA/QB/QC, keepPeople21, l21dChoices, handleDialogueQuestD21, questTick21, stepPlayer21.
scripts/lib/level69-quest.js, scripts/lib/level22-quest.js - Wren/beacon and Emstable quest APIs; scripts/lib/places.js exports canonical place-name/title registries.

scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, weaponOf, gain, HOLO, holoEnd, takeToken, readBookAction, readMagAction, useSnack, weaponAim, onInput; scripts/lib/stats.js - derived/carry/combat helpers; scripts/lib/loot.js - shared loot helpers.
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/save.js - durable character player.state: progression/XP, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, combat, access, appearance, currency and gear shared across Solo/Multiplayer.

scripts/lib/stats.js - derived attributes, skills and combat/carry stats; carry capacity is base + Hardiness + 2 kg per level above 1, plus bonuses; progression migrates through scripts/lib/progression.js.
scripts/lib/run-opts.js + scripts/main-menu.js - mode/run picks; run/quest/story/resume keys swap per mode through SQL slots 91/92 while character and gear remain player.state.
scripts/db.js + scripts/main-menu.js - named save-slot snapshots and hidden Solo/Multiplayer mode snapshots; live character state remains player.state.
scripts/lib/hub.js noteAtlas, called by scripts/player.js on arrival - player.state.atlas first-seen dates/visit counts; place sims own local texture/sign completion stamps.
scripts/lib/doors21-quest.js owns player.state.l21d quest/objective counters and payouts; doors21 sim owns local layout epoch/objects/dead-foe tracking.

scripts/lib/level69-quest.js, level22-quest.js and radio-quest.js own player quest fields l69q/l69planted, l22q and radiomq/radioq/radioSecrets/radioReq/radioGuest; each place sim owns its local room/build state.

places/l31crawl/sim.js owns per-instance built flag; scripts/lib/l31crawl.js defines generated room/door/foe layout and Prize Locker contents; radio sim owns built/live/TV state and radio-use changes player snacks, cents or sanity.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behavior stack for locomotion, interaction, combat, inventory, social, hub, camera, quests, CCTV, radio, barter, phone, emote and god mode; scripts/lib/data/throwables.yml parameters → scripts/player.js throwable behavior.
templates/player.js god-kit.js onInput handles configured U/godMode → editor player.state.god and gear grant; update refills survival values before scripts/player.js core update.
scripts/fall-guard.js holds velocity across place changes for ground streaming; grounded positions refresh session fgSafe, and out-of-bounds restores it or leaves for spawn.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit and aimPt/aimPitch → camera and ballistics/weaponAim; camera uses worldFeetPosition for parented/seated bodies.
Fresh player via scripts/main-menu.js → intake/creator → solo laundromat → tutorial0; laundromat cut and tutorial sim/lib/tutorial drive opening and guidance.
scripts/player.js wake → scripts/lib/save.js migration/log/wakePlace; valid savePlace crosses to saved place and savePos restores coordinates; player update calls clockHeal on arrival.
scripts/lib/run-opts.js mpRoom/toSolo → party or personal room; scripts/bonus-door.js → hub; Bonus glass hall routes to main and main-menu places player outside the return door.
Level 3 door or Boom Town sedan → Level 69 solo instance; Level 69 sim streams road/beacon posts and ramps to Level 11/22; l69-car drives and l69-post → level69-quest plants beacon.

Level 13 tear → doors21; Level 21 exit door 13 → Level 13; west hall hole → Level 22 rubble arrival; Level 22 bottom-floor exit → Level 21 ARRIVE22. Level 21 door dispatch/layout and sim own shifting/RADIO routing.

Level 31 arcade back-room service hatch → scripts/level-door.js mapping l31-to-crawl → l31crawl#crawl-from-l31; crawl-back/service ladder → level31#l31-from-crawl. Crawl sim builds once and returns arrivals below y=-1 to its landing; scripts/l31-bot.js updates underbelly entities.

Level 4 Radio Backrooms door or Level 11 radio-station door → radio; radio exit trigger → Level 11. Radio sim builds/maintains Ralph, ON AIR/TV and world-radio receiver; radio-use ears.press handles coffee/vending/mirror/PC/TV.

Ralph NPC dialogue through npc-starters/talk → radioChoices/handleDialogueQuestRadio; radio-quest owns milk, secrets, song request and guest progression in player.state; station requests are read by the shared radio playback timeline.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild; dining_set composes table and fitted chairs.
scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml + scripts/player.js + ballistics.js + knock.js + loot.js - weapon variants share combat, rarity/level gates and loot; weapon-look.js maps appearance.

scripts/door-geo.js + door-swing.js + prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage and paired leaves; Level 21 composes generated leaves with its own door routing.
scripts/crawl.js + scripts/player.js + humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - global crawl/crouch and gait; held crouch initiates crawl and tight spaces trigger automatic crawl.
scripts/lib/sleep.js + scripts/interact.js + scripts/rest.js + scripts/l178-prop.js - common bed detection/entry, with ordinary rest and Kyoto futon crossing as distinct outcomes.
scripts/lib/l169-road.js + l169-road-geo.js + l169-travel.js + l169-door.js - checkpoint structures vary by site and geometry kind; streamed props include route boards and animated doors.

scripts/lib/l31crawl.js + scripts/l31-bot.js - one crawl layout table and tagged-entity manager reuse patrol/attack/death logic across Rink Wardens and Level 13 lurkers/tenants; behavior/data vary by foe tag and brain stats.

scripts/lib/radio.js + scripts/radio.js + scripts/world-radio.js + places/radio/sim.js - stations share a room-clock timeline; HALOGEN is player-local while room receivers vary by station, reach and reception noise.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists; Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js + scripts/debug-pad.js - debug-room pads after places/debug removal; no current references found.
scripts/lib/data/l178-skins.json - slot-to-texture skin table has no current consumer; x0z0.scene carries material overrides inline.
migrationNotes: Solo and Multiplayer share one character but not run/story state: scripts/lib/run-opts.js isStoryKey defines the swapped key family; MODE_SLOT 91/92 are separate SQL snapshots hidden from ordinary Save Manager slots.

Fresh-player opening chain is main-menu → intake → laundromat → tutorial0; lmDone/arrivePending are player.state flags, while lmSkip and cut timing are session state. Opening places are solo/ephemeral.

Level ! uses places/levelrun/config.yaml solo/ephemeral; CORRIDOR and its 26 m chunk/door generation come from scripts/lib/levelrun-mechanics.js; keep sim geometry and hazard/pursuit/midpoint/collapse/exit depths aligned.

Level 69 slices are 40 m along -Z; the left Level 11 tunnel and right Level 22 ramp repeat every 60 slices (2.4 km), with exits at slice offsets 55 and 28; preserve modulo-based sign, tunnel/ramp geometry and streamed positions.

Level 22 layout uses FF=3.2 m floor spacing; scripts/lib/l22-layout.js defines six tiered decks, cuts, mine/pit and exit, while per-player fallen state in l22 changes panel generation and quest progress is separately in l22q.

Level 31 crawl is solo/ephemeral: its sim lays the room on first tick and moves players below y=-1 to (0, 0.1, 1.5); radio/cells/x0z0.scene is empty and radio sim V=4 builds the room, with fitted models using forward +x. Shock Pad launch height uses throwables.yml launchH calibrated with gMul=2 because observed body fall acceleration differs from place gravity.
